proof_body:
by
  intro K σ _ _ _ I
  rw [MvPolynomial.isMaximal_iff_eq_vanishingIdeal_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, fun p => MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff x p⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, Ideal.ext fun p => (hx p).trans (MvPolynomial.mem_vanishingIdeal_singleton_iff x p).symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (K σ : Type*) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite σ] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial σ K)), I.IsMaximal ↔ ∃ x : σ → K, ∀ p, p ∈ I ↔ MvPolynomial.eval x p = 0
